Update: Nov 10th, 2026 06:41 EST 0 Share facebook twitter whatsapp Make us preferred on Google Certain benefits recipients in the U.S. are getting an early check today , as the Social Security Administration (SSA) begins the Social Security program’s three-Wednesdays payment cycle for November 2026 .
 Why the ahead-of-schedule Social Security payment?
 Each month, most beneficiaries of the Social Security scheme are issued their money on the second, third or fourth Wednesday , with their designated payment date determined by their birthday.
 In November, however, this distribution cycle is kicking in slightly sooner than usual . This is because the month’s second Wednesday falls on Veterans Day , a federal holiday that honors all living and deceased veterans who have served in the U.S.’s armed forces.
 Beneficiaries born between the first and the 10th of any month, who would typically be paid tomorrow, Wednesday 11, will instead get their November money today, Tuesday 10 .
 Social Security’s three-Wednesdays cycle will then revert to its regular schedule on November 18 and 25.
 November 2026’s complete three-Wednesdays cycle:
 Born on 1st-10th of month: Tuesday, Nov. 10 
 Born on 11th-20th of month: Wednesday, Nov. 18 
 Born on 21st-31st of month: Wednesday, Nov. 25 
 NB: If you receive Social Security benefits based on someone else’s work history, the SSA uses the other person’s birthday to determine your designated Wednesday.
 What other Social Security payment dates are there in Nov. 2026?
 Today is the second of four payment dates on the SSA’s Social Security schedule for November. 
 Last week, the agency sent out benefits to two groups of recipients who, each month, are issued their money outside of the three-Wednesdays payment cycle:
 Nov. 3: Social Security issued to double beneficiaries and certain long-term recipients 
 On Tuesday 3 , November’s Social Security benefits were distributed to people who have been receiving their monthly payments since before May 1997 . 
 Tuesday 3 was also this month’s Social Security payment date for beneficiaries who concurrently claim Supplemental Security Income (SSI) checks.
 A needs-based benefit for certain low-income, low-resource Americans , SSI is separate to the Social Security program, despite also being administered by the SSA. 
 Unlike Social Security, applicants to the SSI scheme do not have to earn work credits to qualify. Worth a monthly average of $735.86, SSI was paid out for November on Friday, October 30 . 
 Social Security benefits - average monthly amounts:
 Retirement: $2,034.54 
 Disability: $1,499.41 
 Survivor: $1,636.31 
 Source: The SSA’s ‘monthly statistical snapshot’ , published in Oct. 2026.
 How much is the COLA increase for 2027?
 In an effort to protect beneficiaries’ purchasing power, the SSA revealed last month that it is to increase Social Security and SSI amounts by 3.6% in 2027 . 
 Across all Social Security recipients, this translates into a rise of about $70 on the current average payment , which stands at $1,943.15 per month.
 How does Social Security pay out benefits?
 Direct deposit 
 Beneficiaries of the Social Security program can provide the SSA with their bank details using the online “ my Social Security ” tool.
 Direct Express 
 Alternatively, benefits can be paid onto the Direct Express Card , a special debit card for federal disbursements made to recipients without a bank account. Sign up for Direct Express at 1-800-333-1795 or 1-800-772-1213, or at a Social Security office.
